decision.recommendation: Do not revive027 or create a Dolmenwood-specific canonical-map/VTT clone based only on setting popularity. Preserve existing owner deferral and L1 work.
decision.before: 027 deferred by owner until an adequate manual layer or automation; availability of an official Dolmenwood alternative had not been recorded in researcher observations.
decision.after: Same deferred status and prerequisites, now annotated with the official alternative. Do not pitch canonical hex links/layers/player reveal as an unserved Dolmenwood market by default.
decision.differentiation_hypothesis: An independently useful original-map edit/save/export workflow may remain, but this source does not establish its demand or import compatibility. Generic L1 capability is not disproved by a paid VTT offering.
decision.resume_gate: A specific owner-requested workflow that existing alternatives demonstrably fail to serve, with a concrete retained edit/export result and asset/access constraints. Mere source availability or a counter recheck is insufficient.
decision.why_not_new_task: There is no demonstrated residual product gap in this bounded comparison; another clone/integration proposal would invent demand. No implementation, publication or paid access authorized.
decision.existing_pending_proposal: HX-BL-054/PF2-FILL1-v1 remains proposed; this run does not repeat, approve or alter it.
